            if (xmlHttpRequest.readyState != 4)

            // parse the response entity into object form, while handling

            responseEntity = JSON.parse(

Alter Procedure WRK_MonitorWorkGroupChartData
@filterCriteria nVarchar(MAX),
@culture nvarchar(10)
       
AS
    Set NoCount ON
    DECLARE @warehouse as nVarchar(50);
    DECLARE @criteriaTempTable TABLE (
   filterName nVarchar(300),
   filterValue nVarchar(300))
 /*get the where clause value*/
  INSERT INTO @criteriaTempTable SELECT * FROM fn_GetMonitorFilterParameters(@filterCriteria)
  SELECT @warehouse = filterValue from @criteriaTempTable WHERE filterName = 'FROM_WHS'
   
 
  SELECT 'CHARTDATA_MonitorWorkGroup' AS CHARTDATA_MonitorWorkGroup, CATEGORY = CASE WHEN  WORK_INSTRUCTION.WORK_GROUP IS NULL THEN 'Unassigned' ELSE WORK_INSTRUCTION.WORK_GROUP END,                                                                            
                                                                    COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_INSTRUCTION.WORK_UNIT)AS DATA,
                                                                    DESCRIPTION =CASE WHEN  WORK_INSTRUCTION.WORK_GROUP IS NULL THEN dbo.RSCMfn_RtrvResource('UNASSIGNED',N'text',@culture) ELSE GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL.DESCRIPTION END,

 LEFT OUTER JOIN GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL ON GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL.IDENTIFIER = WORK_INSTRUCTION.WORK_GROUP

/* Summary Tiles End */

    Set NoCount OFF

CREATE PROCEDURE SHP_InsightDetailPaneData(@internalShipmentNum int , @culture nvarchar(10)) 
AS
BEGIN
declare @dockDoorInternalNum numeric(9,0);
select * INTO #tempShipment
FROM SHIPMENT_HEADER_VIEW
WHERE INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum;
SELECT top 1 'SCALAR' AS SCALAR,
    sh.SHIPMENT_ID AS ShipmentID,
    sh.INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM AS InternalShipmentNum,
    sh.ORDER_TYPE AS OrderType ,
    sh.CUSTOMER_name AS Customer,
    sh.ship_to_name AS ShipTo,
    sh.CARRIER AS Carrier ,
    sh.CARRIER_SERVICE AS CarrierService,
    dbo.STSfn_RtrvStsName('outbound' ,sh.TRAILING_STS) AS TrailingSts ,
    dbo.STSfn_RtrvStsName ('outbound' ,sh.LEADING_STS) AS LeadingSts ,
    TOTAL_LINES as SummaryDetails,
    TOTAL_QTY as SummaryUnits,
    TOTAL_VALUE as SummaryValue,
    TOTAL_CONTAINERS as SummaryContainers
FROM #tempShipment sh;
SELECT @dockDoorInternalNum=sl.DOCK_DOOR
FROM #tempShipment sh
LEFT OUTER JOIN Shipping_load sl ON sh.SHIPPING_LOAD_NUM = sl.INTERNAL_LOAD_NUM;
SELECT top 1 'SCALAR' AS SCALAR,
    LOCATION AS DockDoor,
    LOCATION AS LoadDockDoor
FROM LOCATION
WHERE OBJECT_ID=@dockDoorInternalNum;
SELECT 'Template_DetailPaneCustomerAddress' AS Template_DetailPaneCustomerAddress ,
    sh.CUSTOMER_ATTENTION_TO AS AttentionTo,
    sh.customer AS BeforeName ,
    sh.CUSTOMER_NAME AS Name,
    sh.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS1 AS Address1,
    sh.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS2 AS Address2,
    sh.CUSTOMER_ADDRESS3 AS Address3,
    sh.CUSTOMER_CITY AS City,
    sh.customer_state AS [State],
    gcd.[DESCRIPTION] AS Country,
    sh.CUSTOMER_POSTAL_CODE AS PostalCode,
    sh.CUSTOMER_PHONE_NUM AS Phone ,
    sh.CUSTOMER_FAX_NUM AS Fax,
    sh.CUSTOMER_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS Email
FROM #tempShipment sh LEFT OUTER JOIN
GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL gcd on sh.CUSTOMER_COUNTRY = gcd.IDENTIFIER AND gcd.RECORD_TYPE='Country';
SELECT 'Template_DetailPaneShipToAddress' AS Template_DetailPaneShipToAddress ,
    sh.Ship_To_ATTENTION_TO AS AttentionTo,
    sh.Ship_To AS BeforeName ,
    sh.Ship_To_NAME AS Name,
    sh.Ship_To_ADDRESS1 AS Address1,
    sh.Ship_To_ADDRESS2 AS Address2,
    sh.Ship_To_ADDRESS3    AS Address3,
    sh.Ship_To_CITY AS City,
    sh.Ship_To_state AS [State],
    gcd.[DESCRIPTION] AS Country,
    sh.Ship_To_POSTAL_CODE AS PostalCode,
    sh.Ship_To_PHONE_NUM AS Phone ,
    sh.Ship_To_FAX_NUM AS Fax,
    sh.Ship_To_EMAIL_ADDRESS AS Email
FROM #tempShipment sh LEFT OUTER JOIN
GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL gcd on sh.SHIP_TO_COUNTRY = gcd.IDENTIFIER AND gcd.RECORD_TYPE='Country';
select 'Table_DetailPaneDetails' AS Table_DetailPaneDetails,
    ITEM as ITEM,
    [ITEM_DESC] as [DESCRIPTION],
    TOTAL_QTY as TOTALQTY#30,
    QUANTITY_UM as UM
FROM SHIPMENT_DETAIL sd
WHERE sd.INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM = @internalShipmentNum;
SELECT 'Table_DetailPaneDetailsUserDef' AS Table_DetailPaneDetailsUserDef,
    USER_DEF1 as UDSHH1,
    USER_DEF2 as UDSHH2,
    USER_DEF3 as UDSHH3,
    USER_DEF4 AS UDSHH4,
    USER_DEF5 AS UDSHH5,
    USER_DEF6 AS UDSHH6,
    USER_DEF7 AS UDSHH7#40,
    USER_DEF8 AS UDSHH8#40
FROM #tempShipment;
select top 1 'Table_DetailPaneDetailsStatusInfo' AS Table_DetailPaneDetailsStatusInfo,
    dbo.STSfn_RtrvStsName ('outbound',LEADING_STS) as LEADINGSTS,
    dbo.STSfn_RtrvStsName ('outbound',TRAILING_STS) as TRAILINGSTS,
    PRIORITY as [PRIORITY],
    REJECTION_NOTE as REJECTIONNOTE,
    CASE WHEN IMMEDIATE_NEEDS_NOTE is NOT NULL THEN dbo.RSCMfn_RtrvResource(IMMEDIATE_NEEDS_NOTE,'msg',@culture)
    ELSE IMMEDIATE_NEEDS_NOTE END AS IMMEDIATENEEDSNOTE
FROM #tempShipment;
select top 1 'Table_DetailPaneDetailsCarrierInfo' AS Table_DetailPaneDetailsCarrierInfo,
    CARRIER AS CARRIER,
    CARRIER_SERVICE AS CARRIERSERVICE,
    CARRIER_GROUP AS CARRIERGROUP,
    TOTAL_FREIGHT_CHARGE AS TOTALFREIGHT#40,
    FREIGHT_TERMS AS FREIGHTTERMS,
    BOL_NUM_ALPHA AS BOLNUMBER,
    PRO_NUM_ALPHA AS PRONUMBER,
    ROUTE AS [ROUTE]
FROM #tempShipment;
select top 1 'Table_DetailPaneDetailsDates' AS Table_DetailPaneDetailsDates,
    PLANNED_SHIP_DATE AS PLANNEDSHIPDATE ,
    SCHEDULED_SHIP_DATE AS SCHEDULEDSHIPDATE,
    ACTUAL_SHIP_DATE_TIME AS ACTUALSHIPDATE,
    CASE WHEN REQUESTED_DELIVERY_TYPE is NOT NULL THEN dbo.RSCMfn_RtrvResource('DELIVER'+REQUESTED_DELIVERY_TYPE,'text',@culture)
    ELSE REQUESTED_DELIVERY_TYPE END AS REQUESTEDDELIVERYTYPE ,
    PLANNED_DELIVERY_DATE_TIME AS PLANNEDDELIVERYDATE,
    ACTUAL_DELIVERY_DATE_TIME AS ACTUALDELIVERYDATETIME,
    REQUESTED_DELIVERY_DATE AS REQUESTEDDELIVERYDATE
FROM #tempShipment;
SELECT 'Hierarchical_DetailPaneDetailsContainers' AS Hierarchical_DetailPaneDetailsContainers,
    INTERNAL_CONTAINER_NUM AS META_ID,
    PARENT AS META_PARENTID ,
    CONTAINER_ID AS ID,
    CONTAINER_TYPE AS [TYPE],
    dbo.STSfn_RtrvStsName ('outbound',[STATUS]) AS [STATUS],
    dbo.SHIPCONTfn_RtrvCurrentLocation(INTERNAL_CONTAINER_NUM) AS LOCATION,
    INTERNAL_CONTAINER_NUM AS HIDDEN_INTERNALCONTAINERNUM
FROM SHIPPING_CONTAINER
WHERE INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM= @INTERNALSHIPMENTNUM AND CONTAINER_ID IS NOT NULL;
select top 1 'Table_DetailPaneDetailsLoadInfo' AS Table_DetailPaneDetailsLoadInfo,
    sl.INTERNAL_LOAD_NUM as LOADNUMBER,
    sl.CARRIER as CARRIER,
    sl.SCHEDULED_SHIP_DATE AS SCHEDULEDSHIPDATE,
    dbo.STSfn_RtrvStsName ('outbound',sl.LEADING_STS) as LEADINGSTS,
    dbo.STSfn_RtrvStsName ('outbound',sl.TRAILING_STS) as TRAILINGSTS
FROM #tempShipment sh
LEFT OUTER JOIN Shipping_load sl ON sh.SHIPPING_LOAD_NUM = sl.INTERNAL_LOAD_NUM;
SELECT top 1 'Table_DetailPaneDetailsReferenceInfo' AS Table_DetailPaneDetailsReferenceInfo,
    ERP_ORDER                    AS ERPORDER,
    INTERNAL_SHIPMENT_NUM        AS INTERNALSHIPMENTNUM ,
    INTERNAL_ORDER_NUM            AS INTERNALORDERNUM,
    STORE_DISTRIBUTION            AS STOREDISTRIBUTION,
    ORDER_TYPE                    AS ORDERTYPE,
    PROCESS_TYPE                AS PROCESSTYPE,
    (CASE WHEN CONSOLIDATION_DOCK_LOC_AREA IS NOT NULL THEN (CONSOLIDATION_DOCK_LOC_AREA + N'-' + CONSOLIDATION_DOCK_LOC_POS) ELSE NULL END)    AS CONSOLIDATIONLOCATION,
    CONVERT(BIT, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(ALLOCATE_COMPLETE, N'N')= N'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))            AS ALLOCATECOMPLETE,
    CONVERT(BIT, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CONSOLIDATION_ALLOWED, N'N')= N'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))        AS CONSOLIDATIONALLOWED,
    CONVERT(BIT, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CONSOLIDATED, N'N')= N'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))                AS CONSOLIDATED,
    CONVERT(BIT, (CASE WHEN ISNULL(MANUALLY_ENTERED, N'N')= N'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))            AS MANUALLYENTERED
FROM #tempShipment;
END

ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[MOVECLS_MineMovementClassAnalysisData] (
      @Warehouse NVARCHAR(25),
      @Days INT = 90,
      @Permanent NCHAR(1),
      @IncludeArchivedData NCHAR(1),
      @WorkZone NVARCHAR(25) = NULL  --- 'Work Zone has been added under extensibility.'      )
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON;

DECLARE @DateFrom DATETIME
DECLARE @DateTo DATETIME
DECLARE @stErrorMsg NVARCHAR(2000)
DECLARE @rowEffected NUMERIC(9, 0)

SELECT @DateTo = DATEADD(dd, 1, DATEDIFF(dd, 0, GETDATE()))

SELECT @DateFrom = @DateTo - @Days

--Wareshouse should not be null
IF (@Warehouse IS NULL)
BEGIN
      SET @stErrorMsg = N'MSG_INVVAL28';

      RETURN - 1;
END

--Clear MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS table on each run
DELETE
FROM MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS
WHERE WAREHOUSE = @Warehouse

IF UPPER(@PERMANENT) = N'Y'
BEGIN
      INSERT INTO MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS (
            ITEM,
            COMPANY,
            WAREHOUSE,
            LOCATION,
            TOTAL_QUANTITY,
            QUANTITY_UM,
            ITEM_CLASS,
            NUMBER_OF_HITS,
            NUMBER_OF_DAYS,

AS
SELECT 
    ISNULL(
        (
            CASE 
                WHEN (
                ( 
                    SELECT  COUNT(GC.OBJECT_ID) 
                    FROM GENERIC_CONFIG_DETAIL AS GC WITH (NOLOCK) 
                    INNER JOIN ITEM_UNIT_OF_MEASURE AS IU WITH(NOLOCK) 
                        ON GC.IDENTIFIER=IU.ITEM_CLASS
                ) <> 0) 
                THEN ITEM_INFO.ITEMCLASSOBJECTID 
            END
        ),
        
    ITEM_INFO.INTERNALITEMNUM ) AS OBJECT_ID,
    MCA.ITEM,ITEM_INFO.ITEMDESC AS DESCRIPTION,
    ITEM_INFO.ITEMCLASS AS ITEM_CLASS,
    MCA.COMPANY,
    MCA.LOCATION,
    L.LOCATION_TYPE,
    L.LOCATING_ZONE,
    MCA.WAREHOUSE,
    NUMBER_OF_HITS,
    MCA.TOTAL_QUANTITY,
    MCA.QUANTITY_UM,
    MCA.NUMBER_OF_DAYS,
    MCA.DATE_TIME_STAMP,
    ITEM_INFO.VALUEPERITEM * MCA.TOTAL_QUANTITY AS TOTAL_VALUE_PICKED,
    ITEM_INFO.COSTPERITEM * MCA.TOTAL_QUANTITY AS TOTAL_COST_PICKED,
    CONVERSION_INFO.WEIGHTPERITEM * (MCA.TOTAL_QUANTITY/CONVERSION_INFO.CONVERSIONQTY) AS TOTAL_WEIGHT_PICKED,
    ITEM_INFO.MOVEMENTCLASS AS QUANTITY_UM_MOVEMENT_CLASS,
    L.MOVEMENT_CLS AS LOCATION_MOVEMENT_CLASS, 
    CASE 
        WHEN LEN(ILA.ALLOCATION_LOC) > 0 
        THEN 'Y' 
        ELSE 'N' 
    END AS PERMANENT,
    CASE 
        WHEN CONVERSION_INFO.CONVERSIONQUANTITYUM != MCA.QUANTITY_UM 
        THEN MCA.TOTAL_QUANTITY/CONVERSION_INFO.CONVERSIONQTY 
        ELSE MCA.TOTAL_QUANTITY 
    END AS CONVERTED_QTY,
    CONVERSION_INFO.CONVERSIONQUANTITYUM AS CONVERTED_QTY_UM, 
    CONVERSION_INFO.CONVERSIONQUANTITYMOVEMENTCLASS AS CONVERTED_UM_MOVEMENT_CLASS,
    L.WORK_ZONE  --- 'Work Zone has been added under extensibility.'
FROM 
    MOVEMENT_CLASS_ANALYSIS MCA WITH (NOLOCK) 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN ITEM_LOCATION_ASSIGNMENT ILA WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON ILA.WAREHOUSE = MCA.WAREHOUSE
            AND ILA.ALLOCATION_LOC= MCA.LOCATION 
            AND ILA.ITEM = MCA.ITEM 
            AND (ILA.COMPANY = MCA.COMPANY OR (ILA.COMPANY IS NULL AND MCA.COMPANY IS NULL)) 
    LEFT OUTER JOIN LOCATION L WITH (NOLOCK) 
        ON L.LOCATION = MCA.LOCATION 
            AND L.WAREHOUSE = MCA.WAREHOUSE
    OUTER APPLY INVFN_RTRVITEMINFOFORBASEUM(
            MCA.ITEM,
            MCA.COMPANY,
            MCA.WAREHOUSE
            ) AS ITEM_INFO

        MCA.ITEM,
        MCA.COMPANY,
        MCA.WAREHOUSE,
        MCA.LOCATION,
        MCA.TOTAL_QUANTITY,
        MCA.QUANTITY_UM,
        ITEM_INFO.MOVEMENTCLASS, 
        ITEM_INFO.weightPerItem
        ) AS CONVERSION_INFO;

-- Define an temporary variable to store custom colors per dock door
DECLARE @EventColorsPerDockLocation TABLE
(
    DockLocation nvarchar(25),
    BackgroundColor nvarchar(50),
    TextColor nvarchar(50)
);
-- Set the background and text color for dock door that require custom colors
-- You can use any of the CSS color formats such #f00, #ff0000, rgb(255,0,0), or red.
INSERT INTO @EventColorsPerDockLocation VALUES('RCV.1', 'yellow', 'black');
INSERT INTO @EventColorsPerDockLocation VALUES('RCV.2', '#000000', '#ffffff');
-- Join the above table variable with APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULE table and select the backgroundColor, textColor and borderColor column values
SELECT
    BackgroundColor as backgroundColor, TextColor as textColor, BackgroundColor as borderColor, AP.OBJECT_ID as ObjectId, AP.DOCK as Dock, AP.APPT_DATE_TIME as ApptDateTime, AP.END_DATE_TIME as EndDateTime, RH.INTERNAL_RECEIPT_NUM as InternalReceiptNum, RH.RECEIPT_ID as ReceiptId, RH.TRAILER_ID as TrailerId, RH.CARRIER as Carrier
FROM
    APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULE AP JOIN RECEIPT_HEADER RH ON AP.INTERNAL_RECEIPT_NUM = RH.INTERNAL_RECEIPT_NUM
    LEFT OUTER JOIN @EventColorsPerDockLocation ON AP.Dock = DockLocation
WHERE
    RH.WAREHOUSE = @WAREHOUSE AND ((AP.APPT_DATE_TIME <= @apptendDateTime) AND (@apptstartDateTime <= AP.END_DATE_TIME))

CREATE PROCEDURE WRK_MonitorCustomerIndicatorTile(  
@filterCriteria NVARCHAR(MAX),
@indicatorTileName NVARCHAR(100),
@cautionCriteria NVARCHAR(MAX),
@warningCriteria NVARCHAR(MAX),
@culture NVARCHAR(10))
AS
    Set NoCount ON
    DECLARE @warehouse as nVarchar(50);
    DECLARE @criteriaTempTable TABLE(filterName nVarchar(300),filterValue nVarchar(300))
 /*get the where clause value*/
  INSERT INTO @criteriaTempTable SELECT * FROM fn_GetMonitorFilterParameters(@filterCriteria)
  SELECT @warehouse = filterValue from @criteriaTempTable WHERE filterName = N'FROM_WHS'
DECLARE @cautionValue as NUMERIC(9);DECLARE @warningValue as NUMERIC(9);
  IF(@indicatorTileName = N'IndicatorTileAtRiskWork')
   BEGIN
     SELECT TOP 1 N'INDICATORTILE_ATRISKWORK' AS N'INDICATORTILE_ATRISKWORK', COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT) AS N'AT_RISK_WORK',
     'CAUTION' = (SELECT  dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@cautionCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT))),
      'WARNING' = (SELECT dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@warningCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT)))
       FROM WORK_INSTRUCTION WHERE INSTRUCTION_TYPE = N'DETAIL' AND (FROM_WHS =@warehouse) AND CONDITION IN (N'OPEN', N'IN PROCESS') AND AGING_DATE_TIME > DateAdd(DAY, -1, GETDATE())
   END
  ELSE
   IF(@indicatorTileName = N'IndicatorTilePriorityWork')
    BEGIN
     SELECT TOP 1 N'INDICATORTILE_PRIORITYWORK' AS N'INDICATORTILE_PRIORITYWORK', COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT) AS N'PRIORITY_WORK',
     'CAUTION' = (SELECT  dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@cautionCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT))),
      'WARNING' = (SELECT dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@warningCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT)))
       FROM WORK_INSTRUCTION WHERE INSTRUCTION_TYPE = N'DETAIL' AND (FROM_WHS =@warehouse) AND CONDITION IN (N'OPEN', N'IN PROCESS') AND PRIORITY <= 10
    END 
  ELSE
    IF(@indicatorTileName = N'IndicatorTileWorkOnHold')
     BEGIN
     SELECT TOP 1 N'INDICATORTILE_WORKONHOLD' AS N'INDICATORTILE_WORKONHOLD', COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT) AS N'WORK_ON_HOLD',
     'CAUTION' = (SELECT  dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@cautionCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT))),
      'WARNING' = (SELECT dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@warningCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT))) FROM WORK_INSTRUCTION WHERE INSTRUCTION_TYPE = N'DETAIL' AND
      (FROM_WHS =@warehouse) AND CONDITION IN (N'OPEN', N'IN PROCESS') AND HOLD_CODE IS NOT NULL
    END
   ELSE
    IF(@indicatorTileName = N'IndicatorTileOpenWork')
     BEGIN
     SELECT TOP 1 N'INDICATORTILE_OPENWORK' AS N'INDICATORTILE_OPENWORK', COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT) AS N'OPENWORK',
     'CAUTION' = (SELECT  dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@cautionCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT))),
      'WARNING' = (SELECT dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@warningCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT)))  FROM WORK_INSTRUCTION WHERE INSTRUCTION_TYPE = N'DETAIL' AND
      (FROM_WHS =@warehouse) AND CONDITION IN (N'OPEN', N'IN PROCESS')
    END    
    ELSE
    IF(@indicatorTileName = N'IndicatorTileInProgressWork')
     BEGIN
     SELECT TOP 1 N'INDICATORTILE_INPROGRESSWORK' AS N'INDICATORTILE_INPROGRESSWORK', COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT) AS N'INPROGRESSWORK',
     'CAUTION' = (SELECT  dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@cautionCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT))),
      'WARNING' = (SELECT dbo.fn_GetCriticalLevel(@warningCriteria, COUNT(DISTINCT WORK_UNIT))) FROM WORK_INSTRUCTION WHERE INSTRUCTION_TYPE = N'DETAIL' AND
      (FROM_WHS =@warehouse) AND CONDITION IN (N'IN PROCESS') AND USER_ASSIGNED IS NOT NULL 
    END   
   
         
    If @@ERROR <> 0 GoTo ErrorHandler
    Set NoCount OFF
    Return(0)
 
ErrorHandler:
    Return(@@ERROR)

    NULL as backgroundColor, NULL as textColor, AP.OBJECT_ID as ObjectId, AP.DOCK as Dock, AP.APPT_DATE_TIME as ApptDateTime, AP.END_DATE_TIME as EndDateTime, RH.INTERNAL_RECEIPT_NUM as InternalReceiptNum, RH.RECEIPT_ID as ReceiptId, RH.TRAILER_ID as TrailerId, RH.CARRIER as Carrier
FROM
    APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULE AP JOIN RECEIPT_HEADER RH ON AP.INTERNAL_RECEIPT_NUM = RH.INTERNAL_RECEIPT_NUM
WHERE
    RH.WAREHOUSE = @WAREHOUSE AND (AP.APPT_DATE_TIME BETWEEN @apptstartDateTime AND @apptendDateTime OR AP.END_DATE_TIME BETWEEN @apptstartDateTime AND @apptendDateTime)

-- Define an temporary variable to store custom colors per dock door
DECLARE @EventColorsPerDockLocation TABLE
(
    DockLocation nvarchar(25),
    BackgroundColor nvarchar(50),
    TextColor nvarchar(50)
);
-- Set the background and text color for dock door that require custom colors
-- You can use any of the CSS color formats such #f00, #ff0000, rgb(255,0,0), or red.
INSERT INTO @EventColorsPerDockLocation VALUES('RCV.1', 'yellow', 'black');
INSERT INTO @EventColorsPerDockLocation VALUES('RCV.2', '#000000', '#ffffff');
-- Join the above table variable with APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULE table and select the backgroundColor, textColor and borderColor column values
SELECT
    BackgroundColor as backgroundColor, TextColor as textColor, BackgroundColor as borderColor, AP.OBJECT_ID as ObjectId, AP.DOCK as Dock, AP.APPT_DATE_TIME as ApptDateTime, AP.END_DATE_TIME as EndDateTime, RH.INTERNAL_RECEIPT_NUM as InternalReceiptNum, RH.RECEIPT_ID as ReceiptId, RH.TRAILER_ID as TrailerId, RH.CARRIER as Carrier
FROM
    APPOINTMENT_SCHEDULE AP JOIN RECEIPT_HEADER RH ON AP.INTERNAL_RECEIPT_NUM = RH.INTERNAL_RECEIPT_NUM
    LEFT OUTER JOIN @EventColorsPerDockLocation ON AP.Dock = DockLocation
WHERE
    RH.WAREHOUSE = @WAREHOUSE AND (AP.APPT_DATE_TIME BETWEEN @apptstartDateTime AND @apptendDateTime OR AP.END_DATE_TIME BETWEEN @apptstartDateTime AND @apptendDateTime)
